**Subject: Cancelled Class – Rescheduling Information**

Dear [Name],

I’m writing to ask about the class scheduled for [date/time], which was recently cancelled. Will the class be rescheduled, or should participants register for another available session instead? If a new date is planned, could you please let us know when it will be announced? Otherwise, I would appreciate guidance on transferring my registration to a different session.

Thank you for your help. I look forward to your response.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]
